title: Boss: production-ready telemetry for payments
summary: The payments service launches next week. The SRE readiness review has three requirements: traces, metrics and logs. Meet all three, graded by what the SDK really exports.

steps.title: The readiness review
body: **PRR-118: payments service.** Before it takes real traffic, the SRE team asks for:
1. **Traces**: service `payments`; a server span per request; a span `payment authorize` with `app.payment.method` and
`app.payment.amount` (a double); declined payments are marked Error with `error.type` = `card_declined`.
2. **Metrics**: a counter `app.payments` by `app.payment.method` and `app.payment.outcome` (`approved` / `declined`), and a histogram
`app.payment.duration` in seconds whose buckets include the SLO threshold, **0.3 s** (boundaries `0.05, 0.1, 0.3, 1`).
3. **Logs**: a declined payment logs a **Warning** `Payment declined for {Amount} by {Method}`, with the trace id; the `402` response
carries the trace id as `traceId` so support can quote it.
The service: `POST /payments?method=card&amount=120.5`. Amounts above 1 000 are declined (`402`); the rest are approved (`200`,
`{ "status": "approved" }`). Each step adds one requirement and keeps the earlier ones.

steps.title: Requirement 1: traces
prompt: Write the payments service with requirement 1. Use an `ActivitySource` named `Payments.Api` (static, after `app.Run();`).
- amount above 1 000: status Error (description `card declined`), `error.type` = `card_declined`, answer `402` (`Results.StatusCode(402)`);
starter: app.MapPost("/payments", (string method, double amount) => Results.Ok(new { status = "approved" }));
solution: public static readonly ActivitySource Source = new("Payments.Api");
template: public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
DojoWeb.Status("1500 is declined with 402", 402, await http.PostAsync("/payments?method=voucher&amount=1500", null));
var good = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.DisplayName == "payment authorize" && DojoOtel.Tag(a, "app.payment.method") == "card");
var bad = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.DisplayName == "payment authorize" && DojoOtel.Tag(a, "app.payment.method") == "voucher");
var server = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.Kind == ActivityKind.Server);
Dojo.Check("payment authorize spans are exported", good is not null && bad is not null, "Spans: " + string.Join(", ", DojoOtel.Spans.Select(a => a.DisplayName)));
Dojo.Check("app.payment.amount is the double 120.5", good?.GetTagItem("app.payment.amount") is double dojoAmt && dojoAmt == 120.5, "");

steps.title: Requirement 2: metrics
prompt: Keep requirement 1 and add requirement 2 with a `Meter` named `Payments.Api`:
- histogram `app.payment.duration` (unit `s`, seconds of the handler) with `app.payment.method` only;
- a view (or instrument advice) so its boundaries are exactly `0.05, 0.1, 0.3, 1`.
starter: public static readonly ActivitySource Source = new("Payments.Api");
solution: Telemetry.Payments.Add(1, new KeyValuePair<string, object?>("app.payment.method", method), new KeyValuePair<string, object?>("app.payment.outcome", outcome));
public static readonly ActivitySource Source = new("Payments.Api");

public static readonly Histogram<double> Duration = Meter.CreateHistogram<double>("app.payment.duration", unit: "s");

template: public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
Dojo.Check("the 402 body has a traceId", traceId is { Length: 32 }, "got " + (traceId ?? "nothing"));
var span = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.DisplayName == "payment authorize" && a.TraceId.ToHexString() == traceId);
Dojo.Check("it is the trace of the declined payment", span is not null && span.Status == ActivityStatusCode.Error, "");
Dojo.Eq("a Warning with the template", "Payment declined for {Amount} by {Method}", log?.Template);
Dojo.Check("Amount is the double 1500", log?.Attributes.GetValueOrDefault("Amount") is double dojoA && dojoA == 1500, "");
Dojo.Eq("the record has the same trace id", traceId, log?.TraceId);
Dojo.Eq("and the span id of payment authorize", span?.SpanId.ToHexString(), log?.SpanId);
